concerns.text: The definition of `replication_success` (Section 3 ‘Statistical Approach’) requires the test‑set effect size to be within ±20 % of the *known ground‑truth* effect size (`target_effect_size`). The same `target_effect_size` is later used as a predictor in the logistic regression model (FR‑005). This makes the outcome variable directly dependent on one of its predictors, violating the independence requirement of split‑sample validation (Principle VI) and creating a circular/tautological validation where larger effect sizes trivially increase the probability of success.
